name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
summary: First Mate Crazz has learned that the Bloodsail Buccaneers mean to strike Booty Bay. He sends you to warn Fleet Master Seahorn, commander of the Blackwater Raiders, before they move.

sections.title: A Warning for the Fleet Master
sections.body: First Mate Crazz sends you to warn Fleet Master Seahorn of an attack on Booty Bay. Crazz has learned the Bloodsail Buccaneers mean to strike the port directly, and the threat is greater than he first thought. Seahorn is somewhere in town. He must hear the warning before the rival pirates move.

sections.title: Seahorn's Defiance
sections.body: Fleet Master Seahorn dismisses the Bloodsail Buccaneers' plan to attack Booty Bay. He says it is as foolish as leaping from the Overlook Cliffs. Still, he sees the worth of your warning and thanks you on behalf of the Blackwater Raiders.

faq.q: Who sends you to warn Fleet Master Seahorn?
faq.answer: First Mate Crazz sends you to warn Fleet Master Seahorn after learning how far the Bloodsail Buccaneers' hostile plans reach.

faq.q: Where can Fleet Master Seahorn be found?
faq.answer: Fleet Master Seahorn is in Booty Bay, the pirate haven in southern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What is the Bloodsail Buccaneers' scheme?
faq.answer: The Bloodsail Buccaneers are preparing an outright attack on Booty Bay, challenging the Blackwater Raiders' rule over the town.
The Blackwater Raiders hold and operate Booty Bay, and fiercely protect the port from their Bloodsail rivals.
